scenarios.name: Create a selected part template with Enter

background_steps.name: a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/document-creation-native-candidate.opj` as its active project
the native catalog contains metric and inch templates in their respective folders
the catalog root has no direct template files

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
the user presses Control+N to open the new-document template chooser
the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software
the metric template folder is selected
the user selects the standard metric part template
a new empty part document becomes active
its model browser displays an origin and an end-of-part marker
a new document tab is visible
